name: leela
description: Leela — the game of self-knowledge. One engine, one dataset, many surfaces.

scripts.audit:
node -e "const {readdirSync,readFileSync}=require('node:fs');const {execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');const excused=JSON.parse(readFileSync('package.json','utf8')).auditsThisGateCannotRun||{};const excuse=p=>String(excused[p]||'').trim();const onDisk=readdirSync('scripts').filter(n=>n.startsWith('audit-')&&n.endsWith('.mjs')).sort().map(n=>'scripts/'+n);const problems=[];for(const p of Object.keys(excused))if(!onDisk.includes(p))problems.push(p+': excused, and not on disk - an exemption for a file nobody has');for(const p of onDisk)if(excused[p]!==undefined&&excuse(p)==='')problems.push(p+': excused with no reason given');const toRun=onDisk.filter(p=>excuse(p)==='');if(toRun.length===0)problems.push('every audit on disk is excused, so this gate runs nothing');for(const p of onDisk)if(excuse(p)!=='')console.log('excused  '+p+': '+excuse(p));for(const p of toRun){const rt=(readFileSync(p,'utf8').match(/^#!\s*/usr/bin/env\s+(\w+)/)||[])[1];if(!rt){problems.push(p+': no shebang, so nothing says how to run it');continue;}console.log('
--- '+rt+' '+p);try{execFileSync(rt,[p],{stdio:'inherit'});}catch(err){problems.push(p+': '+rt+' exited '+(err.status===undefined||err.status===null?String(err.message).split('
')[0]:err.status));}}if(problems.length){console.error('
'+problems.length+' audit(s) neither ran nor passed:');for(const t of problems)console.error('  '+t);process.exit(1);}console.log('
'+toRun.length+' audits ran and passed, and every other audit-*.mjs on disk is excused above with a reason.');"
scripts.verify: bun run content:build && bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:strict && bun run audit && bun run test

auditsThisGateCannotRun.scripts/audit-pushed.mjs: reads ~/.leela/daily-quote.log, which is on the machine that sends and nowhere else. CI has no such file and its absence is not the absence of a push - the audit exits 2 for that, never 0. Written 2026-08-31 after a morning with no 06:00 line at all: a laptop asleep at six is a push that never happened, recorded only in a file nobody opened. It also catches a send OFF the hour, which is somebody running the sender by hand and every subscriber being pushed to for it.
auditsThisGateCannotRun.scripts/audit-quotes.mjs: reads what the daily push actually sends, and that file is in the donor clone at ../leela-src, which a clone of this repository does not carry. It exits 2 rather than 0 when the donor is absent - the absence of the data is not the absence of a defect and must not read as one, which is the whole reason this audit exists: the launchd sender has pushed to real phones every morning and nothing here had ever read its text. MEASURED 2026-08-29: seven defects in 132 texts, two of them sent inside 48 hours.
auditsThisGateCannotRun.scripts/audit-copies.mjs: reads the copies of the board in the donor clones at ../leela-src, which a clone of this repository does not carry. RE-MEASURED 2026-08-23 and the old note was wrong twice over: it needs `bun`, not the `node` its shebang names, because it imports extensionless TypeScript from packages/engine; and under bun with --src it exits 2, not 0, on one file it cannot read. That was CORRECTED on 2026-08-23 the same day: the hand-check behind it was wrong. leela/src/components/GameBoard/index.tsx DOES declare half a board - SNAKE_HEADS and ARROW_BASES, twenty squares, every origin of every jump - and the audit was right to stop on it. extractOrigins reads that shape now, the twenty agree with the engine exactly, and a disagreeing half takes exit 1. Under bun with --src the audit exits 0.
auditsThisGateCannotRun.scripts/audit-variants.mjs: holds what legacy-mobile and online claim against the apps they were taken from, and those apps live in ../leela-src, not here.
auditsThisGateCannotRun.scripts/audit-podlock.mjs: reads ../leela-src/leela/ios/Podfile.lock against that app's installed node_modules; the published app is a donor clone and the native side is never installed here.
auditsThisGateCannotRun.scripts/audit-serving.mjs: asks the LIVE bot whether it is serving the texts this checkout holds, so it needs the network and a running deployment. CI has neither, and a gate that goes red because Railway was restarting is a gate people stop reading. It is also the wrong shape for CI on purpose: it exits 2 for cannot-tell, and this runner knows only pass and fail. Run it by hand after railway up - that is the moment it answers, and the moment the answer matters.
auditsThisGateCannotRun.scripts/audit-deployment.mjs: asks four public chains where the contract is. MEASURED 2026-08-06: exit 2, because polygon did not answer - a gate that goes red when an RPC rate-limits is one people stop reading.
auditsThisGateCannotRun.scripts/audit-mutants.mjs: edits shipped source on purpose and runs a full suite per decision, minutes of it. A gate must not mutate the tree it is checking, and a run stopped halfway is already caught by content:build and by audit-scripts, both of which read scripts/.mutants-undo.json.
